description: Read per-post and per-account performance the Soclo app already shows on Insights: impressions, reach, likes, comments, shares, saves, views, clicks and engagement rate, plus an overview (total posts, published posts, last sync). Read-only and free. A metric a platform did not report comes back as null, never as 0: null means "Soclo does not have this figure", not "it happened zero times". This never states or implies that any post caused a sale or any revenue; that is a different, explicitly non-causal read (soclo_sales) and is never claimed here.

accountId.description: Limit to one connected account id, from soclo_accounts_list.

source.description: Limit to one connected data source, if the account has more than one.

name: soclo_analytics_performance
title: Read your post performance
